question: Should OpenClaw accept LongCat as an official external provider package with first-class onboarding, catalog metadata, and package/release ownership through the linked PR?
rationale: The provider SDK can support this technically, but adding a new official provider identity, auth choice, env var, docs, and package surface is a maintainer product and ownership decision, and the issue is protected by a maintainer label.

options.title: Accept official external provider
options.body: Review and land the linked PR once the draft is ready, package/release metadata is approved, and optional authenticated smoke proof is added if a LongCat key is available.

options.title: Keep LongCat custom or ClawHub-only
options.body: Decline first-class official metadata for now and leave users on LongCat's documented custom-provider configuration or a community package path.

options.title: Bundle in core instead
options.body: Require a bundled provider plugin only if maintainers explicitly accept the higher core package and release-maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Accept official external provider
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR once the draft is ready, package/release metadata is approved, and optional authenticated smoke proof is added if a LongCat key is available.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue and linked PR and are already assigned to the maintainer decision path.
